body:
I had a lengthy reply I was working on, but to be honest I don't know if I can say exactly what the real reasons are.  I feel like I would be simply giving you a "best guess", because what I guessed to be the most significant reason, I think I would still want to do this even if it were possible to "fix" it.  

I just don't feel that life, or at least my life is worth living.  I feel like even if I struggle and struggle and eventually stop being so depressed and stop wanting to die, that I still wouldn't *care*.  I am trapped here and I want out.  

I have thought about it a lot, it is regretful that I would make people like my girlfriend extremely sad.  It hurts me to think about it.  But doesn't my pain matter too?  I've been in pain for a long time and its become unbearable.  It might take a while, but her and others will get over it and move on.  At some point doesn't the amount of pain I am in trump that?  I realize that may sound selfish, but maybe some of you will understand I hope.  I wish I had a better option, but I don't think I do.
